title: Doors not required to have a fire protection rating.
officialText:
Where pivoted or side-hinged doors are permitted without a
fire protection rating, foam plastic insulation, having aflame spread index of 75 or less and a smoke-developed index of not
more than 450, shall be permitted as a core material without a thermal barrier where the door facing is of metal having a
minimum thickness of 0.032-inch (0.8 mm) aluminum or steel having a base metal thickness of not less than 0.0 16 inch (0.4
mm) at any point.
